sources.name: GitHub MCP Registry
sources.description: A curated slice of the official registry, published by GitHub with its own API.

sources.name: Reference servers
sources.description: The servers the steering group maintains as examples of the protocol done right.

sources.name: Glama
sources.description: One of the largest indexes, with security and quality scores on every listing.

sources.description: An index that also hosts servers for you, so many entries are remote URLs.

sources.description: A large index with weekly news, use cases and a public API.

sources.description: Signed container images. Useful to read, but the gateway image ships no docker.

sources.name: ToolHive Registry
sources.description: A vetted catalog that states the permissions and the tool list of every entry.

sources.name: Awesome MCP Registry
sources.description: Thousands of entries kept as plain JSON in a repository you can read in full.

sources.name: mcp.so
sources.description: The largest search site for servers. Browsing only, it publishes no API.

sources.name: mcpservers.org
sources.description: A hand-kept directory that shows the ready config next to every server.

sources.name: Awesome MCP Servers
sources.description: The list everyone links to, sorted by what the server is actually for.

sources.name: Cline Marketplace
sources.description: Submissions reviewed for the Cline editor, each with install instructions.

sources.name: LobeHub MCP
sources.description: A browsable directory with screenshots, tool lists and a deploy score.

sources.name: Cursor Directory
sources.description: The servers Cursor lists for its own editor, with one-click install links.

sources.name: MCP Market
sources.description: A directory sorted by category, with a short write-up on each server.

sources.name: Agensi
sources.description: A directory that runs an automatic security scan over the listings it accepts.

sources.name: faith.tools
sources.description: A small subregistry that follows the official specification for its entries.

sources.name: mcpm.sh
sources.description: A package manager for servers on the command line, with a registry behind it.

sources.name: Composio
sources.description: Hosted toolkits for hundreds of SaaS products, with auth handled on their side.

sources.name: Pipedream MCP
sources.description: Remote servers over the integrations Pipedream already runs for you.

sources.name: Cloudflare MCP
sources.description: Servers for the Cloudflare products, plus the docs for hosting your own there.

sources.name: Apify MCP Store
sources.description: Scrapers and crawlers from the Apify store, wrapped as servers.

sources.name: Zapier MCP
sources.description: One remote server built from the Zapier actions you pick for it.

sources.name: MCP World
sources.description: Baidu's market, the way to reach Baidu Map and the rest of their services.

sources.name: BigModel MCP
sources.description: Zhipu's market, hosted servers for Chinese platforms and their own models.

sources.name: ModelScope MCP
sources.description: Alibaba's market, thousands of entries with Amap, Alipay and WeChat among them.

sources.name: Higress MCP
sources.description: Servers built for the Higress gateway, many of them Chinese APIs.
